system.description:
You swing your blade from such a low angle it’s almost as if it rose from the hells themselves. Make two melee taijutsu attacks against a target creature in range, dealing your [Weapons damage] +3d6 slashing damage. The shockwave of your attack generates enough friction to spark a flame.

The target creature and all creatures of your choice within your weapons range must make a Dexterity saving throw taking 3d6 Fire damage or half as much on a success. If the original target makes their save, they take no damage.

Chain 2: The flames erupts outward and burns hotter for the moment it exists. All creatures who fail their saving throw have their DR reduced by 4 until the end of your next turn.

Chain 3: This jutsu can be cast as a Bonus Action. If cast in this way, you are set back to Chain 1. At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this above A-

Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
